effective_prompt:
Find every adult butterfly and moth in this photo.
Draw exactly ONE tight bounding box per individual, covering visible wings, body, antennae, and legs.
If two insects overlap, draw two separate boxes.
If an insect is cut by the image edge, box only its visible part.
Do NOT include: caterpillars, pupae, other insects, shadows, background.
Return an empty list if none found.

Return only a JSON array of objects with a bbox_2d field, for example:
[{"bbox_2d": [100, 200, 400, 600]}].
Each box is [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], with coordinates relative to the
image width and height on a scale from 0 to 1000. Do not return pixel coordinates.
Return [] if there are no matching objects. Do not include Markdown or explanations.
